name: Unified Impulse-Based Context Management
description: Refactor context management to use impulses for ALL context (messages, reasoning, files) instead of split message/impulse approach. Memory agent manages everything uniformly.

tasks.description: Add reasoning impulse pointer type to activity-template.ts

prompt.template:
Add a new impulse pointer type for reasoning parts.

## Context

Reasoning tokens from extended thinking models (like o1) are currently stored in MessageV2.ReasoningPart but not tracked as impulses. This prevents the memory agent from properly accounting for reasoning tokens during compaction.

## Task

In `src/session/activity-template.ts`, add a new pointer type to the Impulse.Pointer discriminated union:

```typescript
type ReasoningPointer = {
  type: "reasoning"
  messageID: string
  partID: string
}
```

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] ReasoningPointer type added to schema
- [ ] Type properly integrated into discriminated union
- [ ] Zod schema includes reasoning pointer type
- [ ] TypeScript types regenerate successfully
- [ ] No compilation errors

tasks.description: Implement resolver for reasoning impulse pointers

prompt.template:
Implement the resolver for reasoning impulse pointers in impulse-resolver.ts.

## Task

In `src/session/impulse-resolver.ts`, add a case to handle `reasoning` pointer type:

```typescript
case "reasoning": {
  // Load reasoning part from message storage
  const part = await Storage.read<MessageV2.ReasoningPart>([
    "part",
    impulse.sessionID || input.sessionID,
    pointer.messageID,
    pointer.partID
  ])
  
  if (!part) {
    return `// Reasoning part not found: ${pointer.messageID}/${pointer.partID}`
  }
  
  // Format reasoning content
  return `=== Reasoning ==\n${part.text}`
}
```

## Notes

- Follow existing resolver patterns (memo, file, component, etc.)
- Handle missing parts gracefully with error message
- Format reasoning text clearly for context injection
- Add logging for debugging

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Case added to switch statement
- [ ] Loads reasoning part from storage
- [ ] Returns formatted reasoning text
- [ ] Handles errors gracefully
- [ ] Follows existing resolver patterns

tasks.description: Create reasoning impulses when reasoning parts are streamed
Refactor renegotiateContext to load all impulses internally instead of receiving messages array

prompt.template:
Refactor SessionMemoryAgent.renegotiateContext() to load all impulses internally.

## Context

Currently, renegotiateContext receives a `messages` array parameter. We want it to load ALL impulses (messages, reasoning, context files) internally so the memory agent has a unified view.

## Task

In `src/session/memory-agent.ts`, refactor `renegotiateContext()`:

### 1. Update Function Signature

Change from:
```typescript
export async function renegotiateContext(input: {
  sessionID: string
  messages?: MessageV2.WithParts[] // OLD: direct messages
  messageImpulses?: ActivityTemplate.Impulse.Schema[]
  otherImpulses?: ActivityTemplate.Impulse.Schema[]
  currentTokens: number
  targetTokens: number
  model: { providerID: string; modelID: string }
})
```

To:
```typescript
export async function renegotiateContext(input: {
  sessionID: string
  model: { providerID: string; modelID: string }
})
```

### 2. Load All Impulses Internally

```typescript
// Load ALL impulses from session memory
const allImpulses = await SessionMemory.listImpulses(input.sessionID)

// Categorize impulses by type
const turnImpulses = allImpulses.filter(i => i.type === "messageHistory")
const reasoningImpulses = allImpulses.filter(i => i.type === "reasoning")
const contextImpulses = allImpulses.filter(i => 
  !["messageHistory", "reasoning"].includes(i.type)
)

// Calculate current token usage from LOADED impulses
const currentTokens = allImpulses
  .filter(i => i.loaded)
  .reduce((sum, i) => sum + (i.tokenCount || 0), 0)

// Calculate target tokens (60% of context window)
const model = await Provider.getModel(input.model.providerID, input.model.modelID)
const outputTokens = Math.min(
  model.info.limit.output,
  SessionPrompt.OUTPUT_TOKEN_MAX
)
const usableContext = model.info.limit.context - outputTokens
const targetTokens = Math.floor(usableContext * 0.6)
```

### 3. Update System Prompt

Update the LLM prompt to include impulse categories:

```typescript
const system = SystemPrompt.header(input.model.providerID)
system.push(`You are the Session Memory Agent - context manager for conversational coding assistance.

## Current Situation

- Current tokens: ${currentTokens}
- Target tokens: ${targetTokens}
- Overflow: ${currentTokens - targetTokens} tokens

## Impulses to Manage

**Turn History** (${turnImpulses.length} impulses):
- Message conversation turns
- Recent: last 2-3 turns (keep loaded)
- Old: > 10 turns (consider unloading)

**Reasoning** (${reasoningImpulses.length} impulses):
- Extended thinking from o1/extended models
- Can unload old reasoning if not actively referenced

**Context** (${contextImpulses.length} impulses):
- Files, components, commits, issues
- Keep high-priority and recently accessed
- Unload low-priority or stale context

## Strategy

Decide which impulses to:
1. Keep loaded (essential for current task)
2. Unload (free memory, keep pointer for reload)
3. Delete (no longer relevant)

...
`)
```

### 4. Return Same Interface

Return the same decision structure (backward compatible):

```typescript
return {
  messagesToKeep: [], // Empty (deprecated)
  messagesToRemove: [], // Empty (deprecated)
  messagesToCompress: [], // Empty (deprecated)
  impulsesToUnload: parsed.impulsesToUnload,
  impulsesToDelete: parsed.impulsesToDelete,
  reasoning: parsed.reasoning,
  estimatedTokensSaved: parsed.estimatedTokensSaved,
}
```

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Function signature simplified (no messages parameter)
- [ ] Loads all impulses internally
- [ ] Categorizes impulses by type
- [ ] Calculates tokens from loaded impulses
- [ ] Updates system prompt with impulse categories
- [ ] Returns backward-compatible decision structure
- [ ] No compilation errors
- [ ] Existing tests still pass
